name: tft13_st7789
title: 1.3-inch TFT on an ST7789, SPI with no CS
description: A 240x240 IPS colour display on SPI with seven contacts and no CS: the backlight on BLK; with its select tied low it takes SPI mode 3 and a bus of its own
notes: FP-133H01D on the ribbon of the panel.

front.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened

back.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13, straightened and turned

photo.source: a photo by Anton of his module, 2026-11-13
photo.notes: GND VCC SCL SDA RES DC BLK on the front and on the back: no CS.

silkscreen.source: the back: Size: 1.3 inch, Interface:SPI, Driver IC: ST7789, Pixel:240x240; the front: 240*240 IPS. The size in mm is a square of 1.3 inches across, not measured. Not tried.

mode.source: A module of an ST7789 with no CS takes SPI mode 3, as the libraries for it say, such as TFT_eSPI with TFT_SPI_MODE SPI_MODE3; Anton: it can be taken while nothing else is on its bus. Not tried.

levels.source: VCC is taken as the 3.3 V of the panel. The start is what the ST7789 driver starts with, not tried.
